description: This file contains helper functions to test the behavior of 'git read-tree', particularly focusing on success and failure cases with the dry-run option, ensuring it does not modify the index or working tree, and verifying consistency with and without the -u option.

methods.name: read_tree_must_succeed
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree' with specified arguments succeeds without modifying the index and working tree.

methods.name: read_tree_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that 'git read-tree' with specified arguments fails and does not modify the index.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree' with -u succeeds without changing the index or working tree, and that the working tree remains unchanged.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that 'git read-tree' with -u fails without altering the index or working tree, and that the working tree remains unchanged.
